fn pow2(n: Int) -> Int
  requires (n >= 0)
  ensures (result == (if (n == 0) then 1 else (2 * pow2((n - 1)))))
  ensures (result >= 0)
  effects pure
  example (pow2(0) == 1)
  example (pow2(1) == 2)

fn numpy_unpackbits(a: List[Int]) -> List[Int]
  requires forall x in a: (x >= 0)
  requires forall i in 0..len(a): (a[i] < 256)
  ensures (len(result) == (len(a) * 8))
  ensures forall k in 0..len(result): ((result[k] == 0) or (result[k] == 1))
  ensures forall i in 0..len(a): forall j in 0..8: (result[((i * 8) + j)] == ((a[i] / pow2((7 - j))) % 2))
  ensures forall x in result: (x >= 0)
  effects pure
  example (numpy_unpackbits([]) == [])

  []
